name: Hong Kong Cemetery
text: Hong Kong Cemetery, formerly Hong Kong (Happy Valley) Cemetery and before that Hong Kong Colonial Cemetery, is one of the early Christian cemeteries in Hong Kong dating to its colonial era beginning in 1845. It is located beside the racecourse at Happy Valley, along with the Jewish Cemetery, Hindu Cemetery, Parsee Cemetery, St. Michael's Catholic Cemetery and the Muslim Cemetery.

depictions.name: Hong Kong Cemetery
depictions.text: Hong Kong Cemetery is a location in Sleeping Dogs. The front gate of the cemetery resembles the one in the Aberdeen Chinese Permanent Cemetery in real life. The Cemetery makes two prominent appearances.
